facts.text: The resort offers direct access to the white-sand Choengmon Beach, overlooking the Gulf of Thailand.
facts.excerpt: Kimpton Kitalay Samui offers direct access to the beautiful white-sand Choengmon Beach, overlooking the Gulf of Thailand.

facts.text: The resort blends contemporary design with traditional accents.
facts.excerpt: Kimpton Kitalay Samui is a resort with an enchanting fusion of contemporary design and traditional accents.

facts.text: Accommodation is characterised by pattern and weave, with nautical hints in the villas alluding to the site once being a chief fisherman's home.
facts.excerpt: hints of a nautical personality slowly reveal themselves, alluding to this once being a chief fisherman’s home.

facts.text: Dining venues are FishHouse, SHIO, Boho, SHADES and HOM, covering seafood, beach-inspired cocktails, coffee and modern Thai dishes.
facts.excerpt: FishHouse, SHIO, Boho, SHADES, and HOM feature everything from seafood delights, beach inspired cocktails, rich coffee brews and of course modern Thai favorites.

facts.text: SHIO Japanese Dining & Sushi Bar serves premium fish flown in directly from Japan.
facts.excerpt: Offering exceptional seafood freshness with premium fish flown in directly from Japan.

facts.text: FishHouse Restaurant & Bar is a beach-house-style restaurant specialising in seafood and fish.
facts.excerpt: A Fishmonger’s wife beach house style restaurant specialising in seafood and fish from classics to modern favourites using exceptional ingredients.

facts.text: SHADES Ocean Lounge & Bar is positioned at the oceanfront pool and the beachside.
facts.excerpt: positioned at the oceanfront pool and pristine beachside.

facts.text: Boho Thai Lifestyle Cafe is set in a botanically inspired gallery featuring local Thai arts, handicrafts and florals.
facts.excerpt: set in a botanically inspired gallery, featuring local Thai arts, lifestyle handicraft and florals.

facts.text: The resort has a 500-square-metre Kids Club.
facts.excerpt: Our 500-square-metre Kids Club celebrates adventure and a taste of village living

facts.text: Pets are welcome, and their stay is complimentary whatever their size, weight or breed.
facts.excerpt: No matter what your pets' size, weight or breed, their stay is complimentary.

facts.text: The resort has an oceanfront main swimming pool open to all guests.
facts.excerpt: Seafront Olympic-sized swimming pool that is available to all guests of our resort.

facts.text: Kitavaree Spa & Wellness is the on-site spa.
A complimentary cocktail hour is offered.
Nearby experiences include the island's gallery scene and tours of an independent rum distillery, a Thai micro farm and a fishing village.
facts.excerpt: explore the thriving gallery scene on the island or take tours of local attractions such as an independent rum distillery, a Thai micro farm, or an authentic fishing village

facts.text: There is no local area shuttle at the hotel.
facts.excerpt: There is no local area shuttle available at this hotel.

facts.text: An airport shuttle from Samui International Airport is not available.
Breakfast is free with the stay.
facts.excerpt: Breakfast is free with your stay at the Kimpton Kitalay Samui.
